paragraphs: ([Ezekiel son of Buzi the Kohen](https://www.sefaria.org/Ezekiel.1.3).) Rav Chama bar Buzi: [Berakhot 50a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.50a.13).[^1]

notes.text: In the linked Bavli, Rav Chama bar Buzi and Ravina visit the household of the Exilarch. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1349&lang=en) cites that episode. The biblical reference is a separate namesake.
